entfernt.satz: The verifier generates 92 rule-conforming topologies with two bound states.

The 50 proofs are those of the 50-topology theorem [C-proofreading-R11], and the 11 violations are those of the violation theorems [C-proofreading-R4] [C-proofreading-R12] [C-proofreading-O14], with the exact values in the table below [C-fakt-verletzungen-eta].
entfernt.grund: Zahl(en) [11.0] stehen in keiner zitierten Claim

entfernt.satz: Among the 88 non-degenerate topologies with two bound states, 50 satisfy $\eta \geq e^{-2\Delta}$ for all rates and fuel potentials (certificate (b)), 11 have an exactly certified violation $\eta < e^{-2\Delta}$ (fam2_9, fam2_11, fam2_35, fam2_39, fam2_41, fam2_43, fam2_45, fam2_58, fam2_66, fam2_67, fam2_75), and 27 are open [C-fakt-klassifikation] [C-fakt-familie].
entfernt.grund: Quantor/Verallgemeinerung ohne Allaussage im zitierten Claim; sage „at the points examined (...)“ oder streiche den Quantor

story.kernfrage: Does the Hopfield bound eta >= e^{-(n+1)Delta} on the error rate of kinetic proofreading hold as a universal limit for all Markov networks with two bound states, or can network topologies with fuel-driven discard pathways break it?
story.kernaussage: For the linear Hopfield chain with n=2 the bound eta >= e^{-3Delta} is proven for all rates and fuel potentials, but e^{-2Delta} is not a universal limit for networks with at most two bound states: of the 88 admissible topologies, 50 provably obey eta >= e^{-2Delta}, 11 have exactly certified violations (eta < 10^-4, down to about 10^-12), and 27 remain open.
story.titel: Exact classification of the bound $e^{-2\Delta}$ on proofreading error rates in Markov networks with two bound states
story.keywords: kinetic proofreading, error rate bound, Hopfield limit, Markov networks, entropy production, exact certificates
